officialTitle: Inavolisib-Based Therapy in PIK3CA-Mutated Advanced Breast Cancer
subtypes: Endocrine-resistant (relapse during or within 12 months of adjuvant endocrine therapy)
setting: First-line advanced, early relapse on/after adjuvant endocrine therapy

design.notes: 161 patients assigned to inavolisib and 164 to placebo.

clinicalQuestion: Does adding inavolisib to palbociclib-fulvestrant improve PFS as first-line therapy for PIK3CA-mutated, HR-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer with early relapse after adjuvant endocrine therapy?

pico.population: PIK3CA-mutated, HR-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer relapsing during or within 12 months after completing adjuvant endocrine therapy
pico.intervention: Inavolisib 9 mg once daily plus palbociclib-fulvestrant
pico.outcomes: Primary: investigator-assessed PFS. Secondary: objective response, safety

arms.label: Inavolisib + palbociclib + fulvestrant
arms.doseSourceQuote: we compared first-line inavolisib (at an oral dose of 9 mg once daily) plus palbociclib-fulvestrant (inavolisib group) with placebo plus palbociclib-fulvestrant (placebo group)

publications.title: Inavolisib-Based Therapy in PIK3CA-Mutated Advanced Breast Cancer.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: A total of 161 patients were assigned to the inavolisib group and 164 to the placebo group; the median follow-up was 21.3 months and 21.5 months, respectively. The median progression-free survival was 15.0 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 11.3 to 20.5) in the inavolisib group and 7.3 months (95% CI, 5.6 to 9.3) in the placebo group (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.43; 95% CI, 0.32 to 0.59; P<0.001).
An objective response occurred in 58.4% of the patients in the inavolisib group and in 25.0% of those in the placebo group.

safety.sourceQuote: The incidence of grade 3 or 4 neutropenia was 80.2% in the inavolisib group and 78.4% in the placebo group

safety.description: Discontinuation of any trial agent because of adverse events
safety.sourceQuote: Discontinuation of any trial agent because of adverse events occurred in 6.8% of the patients in the inavolisib group and in 0.6% of those in the placebo group.

strengths: Double-blind randomised phase III trial in a biomarker-selected, endocrine-resistant population
Triplet tested against an active CDK4/6 inhibitor-based control
limitations: Restricted to early relapse after adjuvant endocrine therapy; not generalisable to endocrine-sensitive first-line disease
Primary endpoint investigator-assessed; OS not mature in the primary publication

clinicalImplications.text: Supports adding inavolisib to palbociclib-fulvestrant for first-line treatment of PIK3CA-mutated, HR-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer with early relapse after adjuvant endocrine therapy, making PIK3CA testing relevant at first metastatic relapse.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Early relapse (on or within 12 months of adjuvant endocrine therapy) plus a PIK3CA mutation is the INAVO120 population — test PIK3CA at first relapse.

curation.notes: Numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 39476340. PubMed text strips the italic gene symbol PIK3CA from title and abstract; restored in the title field only. Total sample size not printed as a single figure, so design.sampleSize omitted.
